WITH order_invoice_counts AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, COUNT(i.invoice_number) AS invoice_count
  FROM Orders o
  LEFT JOIN Invoices i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
  GROUP BY o.order_id
), order_shares AS (
  SELECT order_id,
         invoice_count,
         1.0 * invoice_count / NULLIF(SUM(invoice_count) OVER (), 0) AS invoice_share
  FROM order_invoice_counts
), average_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(invoice_share) AS avg_share
  FROM order_shares
)
SELECT SUM(os.invoice_count) AS total_invoices,
       a.avg_share AS average_share,
       AVG(os.invoice_share - a.avg_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM order_shares os
CROSS JOIN average_share a
WHERE os.invoice_share > a.avg_share;
